pr_comments:
/test pull-kubernetes-integration 
the failed test seems unrelated to the code change

> are you planning to move the pvCache to be managed as plugin state?

you mean `pvCache` hold by `volumeBinder`? 

no, the `pvCache` and `pvcCache` hold by `volumeBinder` must be shared by all pods. like assumed cache maintained by the scheduler, after a PV is reserved, it should not be picked by other pods in the next scheduler cycles until it's unreserved due to some failures in binding.

> > are you planning to move the pvCache to be managed as plugin state?
> 
> you mean `pvCache` hold by `volumeBinder`?
> 
> no, the `pvCache` and `pvcCache` hold by `volumeBinder` must be shared by all pods. like assumed cache maintained by the scheduler, after a PV is reserved, it should not be picked by other pods in the next scheduler cycles until it's unreserved due to some failures in binding.

Plugin state is different from CycleState. pvCache and pvcCache can be maintained in the plugin itself (i.e., members of the VolumeBinding struct itself), and so practically moving the last pieces of code you have in `pkg/controller/volume/scheduling` to the plugin itself.

/approve
/hold 

for scheduler changes, holding for @msau42 review

> > > are you planning to move the pvCache to be managed as plugin state?
> > 
> > 
> > you mean `pvCache` hold by `volumeBinder`?
> > no, the `pvCache` and `pvcCache` hold by `volumeBinder` must be shared by all pods. like assumed cache maintained by the scheduler, after a PV is reserved, it should not be picked by other pods in the next scheduler cycles until it's unreserved due to some failures in binding.
